To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the contact with a former surgical lung cancer patient can be a valuable source of support for patients during their hospital stay, and this is a result of the exchange of narratives.
patients experience the support of a peer as an opportunity to share experiences with others in similar situations.
the patients experienced that exchanging narratives with a peer was easier than talking to nurses and that the contact with a former peer helped them to find their way out of the disease perspective.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how patients and former patients experience talking to each other, and how the contact between them can support the patients' illness experience.
the importance of the patient's own story in the care of the individual.
the importance of narrative and the role of narrative in health care.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
peer support is an important part of nursing care and should be included in nursing care planning.
patients can support each other by exchanging stories and experiences.
patients can be empowered through the exchange of stories with a former patient.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the peer support concept has the potential to complement and strengthen the care provided by the healthcare professionals.
the exchange of stories is a way of creating meaning and understanding of the illness and its treatment.
patients can support each other in the hospital environment, and that the support they provide can be empowering.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the peer support concept should be further developed and implemented as an integral component of patient care.
it is important to be aware of the value of peer support, and it can be used as a complement to professional support.
patients can benefit from talking with a peer about the illness, and the nurse can be a facilitator in this process.
